display.summary: The Updates card tells the truth: a check that finds nothing turns green at once, a locally built image is not offered the registry image, the update target no longer shows the baked DjangoLux version, and Composer checks that cannot complete say why.
highlights: DjangoLux's check icon turns green as soon as a check finds nothing newer, without a reload.
A locally built application image shows a neutral Local build icon instead of a permanent update.
The update target is the project's version or the build's digest; the baked DjangoLux version is labelled separately.
The Composer agent row explains an unreadable registry; the deployment check offers Apply repairs from its results, or says none is available.
